ev.q: Five cases were identified in four states
four of whom reported exposure to a ball python in the residence
one each in Arizona, Oklahoma, and Oregon, and two in Indiana
Median patient age was 10 years (range = <1–40 years), and four were female.
four of whom reported exposure to a ball python in the residence
An outbreak investigation was initiated to identify the source of infection.

methods_quotes.q: hqSNPs were called at >20x coverage, >95% read support, and allowed Flanking set to five base pairs
Traceback of patients’ snakes was conducted by contacting snake purchase locations to identify common suppliers.
